_about: How the F39 rank twists LOOK (looks only: nothing here changes a rule). wild = wild goop (rank 40+, seals any colour of crack), from the sketch .planning/research/sketches/wild-goop.html — paste its 'Copy values' here (its look 0 / 1 / 2 = rainbow / oil / pearl; pixelSize isn't in the game). It must never read as a real goop colour, as black goop or as white (the Veteran). twoColour = the soft glow round a two-colour piece as it falls (story.md rank 20: 'a multi-colour piece glows as it falls'). Drawn by both goo renderers (Jelly + Particle) and the tank canvas (ghost, next window); on the looks clock.

_help.wild.look: Which wild look: oil = a grey-violet body with a rainbow film sliding over it (Claude's pick) · rainbow = v1's wave through the real goop colours (it IS red for a moment — the problem) · pearl = milky lavender with a pastel shimmer.
_help.wild.speed: How fast the colour moves. Rainbow: 1 = v1's 400 ms per colour. Oil: how fast the shiny band slides across. Pearl: how fast the shimmer drifts and the glow pulses. 0 = frozen.
_help.wild.band: Size of the colour bands, in cells. Rainbow: cells from one colour to the next. Oil: how wide the shiny band is. Pearl: how big the shimmer swirls are.
_help.wild.saturation: How colourful the sheen gets (0 = grey). Rainbow at 1 = exactly the real goop colours. Oil / Pearl top out well below a real goop.
_help.wild.tint: How bright the wild body is under the sheen. Oil: dark gunmetal (0) to pewter (1). Pearl: dusky lavender (0) to bright pearl (1, still short of white). Rainbow: dimmer / brighter.
_help.wild.glow: A soft halo round each wild clump that gently pulses, plus a glowing rim: 'this one is special'. 0 = none.
_help.wild.sparkle: Tiny twinkles on wild goop only. 0 = none, 1 = lots.
_help.twoColour.glow: A soft glow round a two-colour piece while it falls (each half in its own colour). 0 = none.
_help.twoColour.size: How far the glow reaches past each cell (cells).
_help.twoColour.pulseHz: How fast the glow breathes (pulses per second; 0 = steady).
